message:
2 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      support/css.ts:2 — `readComputedStyleProperty`, imported from `..`
      support/css.ts:7 — `cssName`, imported from `.`
    Every
why: `styleOf` kept as a thin name over a reader in the suite's root module, reached by `..`, and a name helper from the support tree's own index, reached by `.`; the corpus holds neither. Its definition is here and reaches no read the scanner can see, so `styleOf` stops being a reader and every colour the specs take goes quiet — the dropped file one hop further away. The imports are a support file's, not a spec's; the first is spread over lines as prettier writes it past eighty columns, with a comment between its names and the reader second.
